{{Quote|The central computer reported disturbances in zone two of the starboard hangar arm."<br />"What disturbances?"<br />"Droids are firing on one of the cargo containers."|The Gran officer to [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]]|<ref name="CoD" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] who served as an officer for [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]] on the bridge of the ''[[Revenue]]'', a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehalk''-class battleship]]. The Gran handled the [[Central Control Computer/Legends|Central Control Computer]] which controlled [[Droid/Legends|droids]] aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="CoD" /> In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].</ref> the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]]  [[Arwen Cohl]] and his crew infiltrated the ship. The Gran, Dofine, and the rest of the crew escaped to the [[Acquisitor (Lucrehulk-class battleship)|''Acquisitor'']], which arrived on the [[Dorvalla system/Legends|Dorvalla system]] as reinforcement.<ref name="CoD" />
